scope: Fix code text undo and formula sheet reopening; full affected-package regression and Android hardware verification of final heading/distributed typography.

fixes.issue: Code block text undo discarded by paragraph history resolution
fixes.cause: Code nodes were given paragraph-only props and cses_paragraph_target. AppFlowy text inverse snapshots carry original node attributes, so the resolver treated code text undo as an invalid paragraph target and removed it.
fixes.change: Only paragraph-family nodes receive paragraph formatting/history projection; code nodes retain code-specific attrs and ordinary text undo.
fixes.regression: Remote header refresh, text edit, undo, redo and undo again preserve the current Rust/name header and expected text.

fixes.issue: Formula sheet cannot reopen after cancelling with a text range selected
fixes.cause: Restoring the range also reopened the mobile selection toolbar above the formula. The toolbar intercepted the next formula tap.
fixes.change: Modal completion temporarily marks its restoration events as disableFloatingToolbar, including Android input recovery, then restores prior selection extra info only if the session still owns it.
fixes.regression: Cancellation restores the original range, leaves no selection-menu overlay, and a subsequent real tap opens the formula editor; save and undo still work. Existing modal-focus and later selection-menu tests remain passing.

failures: remote header refresh preserves node, caret, and undo history
editing preview is local until save; cancel restores selected body
